releaseNotes:
Feature: Telegram Terminal opens a favorite SSH session, sends each line to the server, and returns output as a shell block with Exit and the current directory
Feature: While the agent is busy, the next Telegram message stays queued and you get a notice until the current turn finishes
Fix: Telegram sends the full plan file instead of the short stub
Fix: A command typed in the terminal while SSH is disconnected stays there (pick a server or Exit) instead of starting the agent
